question: India qualified for the ____ FIFA World Cup in Brazil but AIFF refused to send a team citing 'disagreements over team selection and insufficient practice time.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1950**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India qualified for the **1950 FIFA World Cup**, which was hosted by **Brazil**, marking the first time the tournament was held after **World War II**.
 
• The Indian team earned their spot automatically after other nations in the **Asian qualification group**, including **Burma**, **Indonesia**, and the **Philippines**, withdrew from the competition
